definitions.cancel_compatible_terminal_window: the window [last fill hard low - D, removal hi] of a filled top-3 order whose end is an EX|PL tie (exhaustion and cancellation both feasible); every saved row is identification tied: never an identified cancellation or decision time
definitions.enriched: diff > 0 and p_upper_refdraw <= 0.05 with n_reps >= 200: this packet's conservative reading of the contract word (the diff-only reading is reported beside)
definitions.exhausted_proven_reference: S_FIFO removal set = {exhausted}: a priority-conditional reference whose window is fixed by the last fill hard low to hi; order age, remaining size and remaining market time are not matched to the cancel-compatible events; published separately, never pooled
definitions.families: presence = the declared primary reference: a union of same-side certain-presence spans (a relay of orders passes and the control uses the event order price) with active-span fallbacks pooled in its means; fill_anchored = the declared supplementary countercheck anchored at non-last fills of valid same-side orders; the two families support different event subsets (the membership table), not a same-row decomposition
definitions.p_refdraw: p_upper / p_lower_refdraw = (1 + #replicates >= / <= obs) / (1 + n) over >= 200 reference-draw replicates of the group statistic: a conditional reference-draw tail fraction, not independent-day confidence
definitions.population: ex-ante top 3 (rank1-3) x the 19 BOOK markets, Oct 24-27 2026: 4 consumed days, point estimates, no interval (G = 4 < 5); filled orders are outcome-selected, take records are complete
definitions.successor_le5s: a later first-filled same-side hash of the address within 5 s (x_links refill / reprice): not an identified replacement after a cancellation
definitions.take_btc: btc_with / against_take_side_<w> = BTC with / against the TAKE side (chain_take.window_feats receives s = the take side in YES space); for a reducing take, BTC against the take side is BTC with the inventory held before it; the inventory-aligned reading of the saved statistic is withdrawn and no new null is built
definitions.take_case_alignment: cases only, no matched reference: per class, the BTC window category in take-side alignment and in row-level inventory alignment; inventory side = the sign of the position held before the take: -take side for the reducing classes and overshoot, +take side for add, undetermined for timing_sensitive / from_flat / no_change / unclassified
definitions.take_excluded_before: inventory classes come from status-ok legs; a take with an earlier excluded leg is conditional on the retained ledger (counted per class; every class table is also shown without these takes)
definitions.take_reference: matched no-take instants of the same address and market: stratum = phase (pre / live, not remaining time), recorded position sign, |position| bin; fallback1 drops the sign, fallback2 the |position| bin as well; every level enters the saved estimates
